title: German quick grocery delivery startup Flink raised $100M led by Prosus, a source says at a $900M valuation; Flink was reportedly valued at $5B in May 2022 (Christina Kyriasoglou/Bloomberg)
summary: Christina Kyriasoglou / Bloomberg: German quick grocery delivery startup Flink raised $100M led by Prosus, a source says at a $900M valuation; Flink was reportedly valued at $5B in May 2022 — Flink SE raised funds in a round that values the firm at $900 million, in a sign that the grocery delivery startup has stabilized …
